title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Eversaloon
entities.description: An extraplanar respite that appears at the moment it is most needed, told of in travelers' stories.

entities.name: Nathan Steuer
entities.description: World Champion XXVIII.

entities.name: Akul the Unrepentant
entities.description: Leader of the Hellspurs, crackling with rage and stolen thunder, obsessed with the mystery of Tarnation's great vault.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: A place with a great vault whose contents are unknown.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's outlaw followers, driven to ever-greater violence.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: An undead outlaw joining what he expects to be the greatest heist of his unlife.

entities.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
entities.description: A figure who speaks to growing little ones about a new day.

entities.name: Annie
entities.description: An outlaw taking one last job before retiring in peace.

entities.name: Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher
entities.description: A traveling rancher who has found a world where the herds listen to him but the plants have an attitude.

entities.name: Eriette, the Beguiler
entities.description: A beguiler who promises that dreams will align with hers.

entities.name: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds
entities.description: A former member of the Naya clans who now embraces the untamed wilderness.

entities.name: Conclave
entities.description: A group Ghired dismisses as soft.

entities.name: Clans
entities.description: Groups Ghired calls trapped beasts.

entities.name: Kellan, the Kid
entities.description: A young man who has found out who he was and now seeks to discover who he is.

entities.name: Malcolm, the Eyes
entities.description: A lookout who notes that folks rarely look up.

entities.name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
entities.description: A deadly card dealer.

entities.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
entities.description: A figure who tells others they are living on borrowed time.

entities.name: Satoru, the Infiltrator
entities.description: An infiltrator who claims no wall, ward, or guard in this backwater can keep him out.

entities.name: Taii Wakeen, Perfect Shot
entities.description: A sharpshooter.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins Oko's scheme while hiding her own.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who believes he holds all the cards.

entities.name: Wylie Duke, Atiin Hero
entities.description: A traveler of many worlds who protects the innocent from those who prey on them.

entities.name: Goldvein Hydra
entities.description: A hydra that sprouts many heads and must be slain before fear outpaces greed.

entities.name: Stoic Sphinx
entities.description: A mighty winged creature reported among the geysers.

events.summary: Akul's obsession is fueled by the mystery of what lies inside Tarnation's great vault.
events.quote: Akul didn't know what lay inside Tarnation's great vault, but the mystery fueled his obsession.

events.summary: Tinybones joins up for a heist.
events.quote: It was going to be the greatest heist of his unlife.

events.summary: Annie joins up for one last job.
events.quote: One last job, then she could retire in peace.

events.summary: Vraska joins Oko's crew while secretly pursuing her own scheme.
events.quote: Letting Oko believe he held all the cards provided the perfect cover for her own scheme to unfold.

relations.quote: he drives the Hellspurs to ever-greater heights of violence.

relations.note: Works with Oko while deceiving him
